instructions.name: claim_item_equipment
docs: Claim an item for exactly one canonical Player account. Only the Player
program can sign the capability PDA accepted by this instruction.

accounts.name: equipment_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving all Player/loadout invariants were checked.

instructions.name: close_config
docs: Close this Universe's root LootConfig. Universe authority only — this
invalidates its `roll_loot` / `create_item` flows until reinitialized.

instructions.name: close_empty_item_account
docs: Close a placeholder no-drop item account and return rent to payer.
Used when create_item/create_item_with_payer rolled no item.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receiver for rent refund.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Placeholder item account to close.

instructions.name: create_item
docs: Create an item account. CPI-only — cannot be called directly by users.

accounts.name: loot_authority
docs: Dungeon-program PDA signer proving this mint request came from
authoritative dungeon loot settlement.

instructions.name: create_item_with_payer
docs: Create an item with a separate payer (for session-aware CPI calls). CPI-only.
Owner is used for seed derivation and ownership, payer pays for account

accounts.name: payer
docs: The payer for account creation (e.g., session signer)

accounts.name: loot_authority
docs: Dungeon-program PDA signer proving this mint request came from
authoritative dungeon loot settlement.

instructions.name: destroy_item
docs: Destroy an inventory item through the Player program and invalidate all
equipment caches before the account is closed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Current owner of the item.

accounts.name: destroy_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving inventory/equipment checks ran before close.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Item account to destroy. Must be owned by signer.

instructions.name: destroy_item_with_session
docs: Destroy an unclaimed item using a valid player session, without a rarity
restriction. The Player program exposes this only for exact dead-player
preserved-slot recovery.

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session key signer.

accounts.name: destroy_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving inventory/equipment checks ran before close.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Item account to close to escrow.

instructions.name: destroy_lowest_rarity_item_with_session
docs: Destroy a lowest-rarity item using a valid player session.
Rent from item close is returned to the player's session escrow PDA.

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session key signer.

accounts.name: destroy_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving inventory/equipment checks ran before close.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Item account to close to escrow.

instructions.name: release_item_equipment
docs: Release an equipment claim. The exact Player account that owns the
claim must be supplied, preventing one character from clearing another.

accounts.name: equipment_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving all Player/loadout invariants were checked.

instructions.name: set_item_tags
docs: Replaces the authored traits on a concrete item instance.
Structural facts such as rarity, slot, and concrete item type remain
derived from the typed item fields and therefore cannot drift. The live
Universe root and the optional tag-specific delegate are authorized.

instructions.name: transfer_item_ownership
docs: Transfer ownership of an item (called via CPI from player program)

accounts.name: current_owner
docs: Current owner of the item

accounts.name: transfer_authority
docs: Player-program PDA proving the CPI came through authorized trade logic.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Item account to transfer ownership of

types.name: BaseStats
docs: Base stats for items

types.name: Item
docs: Complete item definition

fields.name: tags
docs: Authored semantic traits. Rarity, kind, slot, specials, and modifiers are derived tags.

types.name: ItemAccount
docs: Equippable item account - stored on-chain

fields.name: universe
docs: Universe whose content and economy this item belongs to.

fields.name: genesis_owner
docs: Immutable wallet used in this account's PDA. Ownership may change,
while this provenance keeps the account address verifiable forever.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Wallet that funded account creation and is entitled to reclaim a
no-drop placeholder's rent.

fields.name: equipped_by
docs: Canonical Player account currently claiming this item, or the zero
pubkey when it is not equipped. The Items program owns this lock so
every transfer/destruction path can enforce global uniqueness.

types.name: ItemKind
docs: Tagged item kind using per-slot enums.

types.name: ItemSlot
docs: Equipment slots where items can be equipped

types.name: LootConfig
docs: Universe-wide loot roll configuration. Administrative authority is read
from the canonical Universe account so ownership transfers cannot leave a
stale controller duplicated here.

types.name: LootRollRequest
docs: Loot roll request parameters

fields.name: actor_tags
docs: Additional/effective role tags supplied by the authoritative caller.

types.name: Modifier
docs: A modifier on an item

types.name: ModifierSource
docs: Types of modifiers that can be on items

types.name: ModifierType
docs: Modifier stat/effect category.

types.name: Rarity
docs: Item rarity tiers

types.name: SpecialAbility
docs: Special abilities for weapons

types.name: TagClauseV1
docs: One canonical fixed-capacity predicate clause.
The active prefix is nonzero, sorted, and unique. Unused slots must remain
zero-filled, preserving one deterministic wire representation per clause.

types.name: TagEffect
docs: A fixed-width rule result. Basis-point channels use 10_000 = 100%.

types.name: TagEffectChannel
docs: Orthogonal numeric channels produced by tag rules.

types.name: TagPredicateV1
docs: Allocation-free role predicate.
`required_all` must all be present. At least one `required_any` tag must be
present unless that clause is empty. No `forbidden_any` tag may be present.

types.name: TagRegistry
docs: Universe-scoped root for authority, custom-ID allocation, and rulebook activation.

fields.name: delegate_authority
docs: Optional tag-specific delegate. The zero key means no delegate.
Universe root/delegated admins are authorized independently of this role.

fields.name: equipment_content_revision
docs: Monotonic invalidation epoch for cached equipment state. Any mutation
to a concrete item's authored tags or canonical ItemTypeConfig bumps it.

types.name: TagRuleV1
docs: A bounded predicate for each role in the tag context.

types.name: TagRulebook
docs: A preallocated rulebook that becomes immutable once sealed.
Rules may be appended over multiple transactions until `seal` computes the
canonical digest and locks the account. Publishing a replacement creates a
new version whose `previous_rulebook` points to the formerly active account.

types.name: TagSetV1
docs: A fixed-capacity set stored as a strict ascending prefix and zero padding.
Deserialization cannot enforce semantic invariants, so account/argument
boundaries must call [`TagSetV1::validate`] (or a higher-level API that does).

types.name: TagStage
docs: Runtime boundary at which a tag rule may be evaluated.

types.name: Universe
docs: Stable root identity and authority boundary for one independent game world.
